subject: Attestation request: confirmation of non-learning processing & export controls
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimblehealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@nimblehealth.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Attestation request: non-learning processing for pilot

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — NimbleHealth is excited about Redwood's low-latency inference for our triage assistant. Procurement asked me to get a short attestation in writing around two items before we can proceed to SOW signoff:

1) Confirmation that customer inputs will not be used to improve or retrain models (no-model-learning) unless explicitly agreed in writing.
2) Controls and proof points for data export/custody: we need to understand where prompt/response logs are stored, how long they are retained, and an SFTP or API path to export logs for our records.

Attached is a standard procurement questionnaire (PDF) — mostly checkboxes. Can your team fill the attestation and provide any supporting diagrams or an export path? Our legal team wants to see evidence before the purchase order is issued.

Appreciate a quick turnaround; we are aiming to finalize by next Friday.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Product Ops | NimbleHealth
elena.rossi@nimblehealth.com
+1 415-555-0123

[Attachment: procurement_questionnaire.pdf]

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Attestation request: non-learning processing for pilot

Elena — thanks for sending this over. High level: we can confirm a default, enforceable operational stance for the NimbleHealth pilot that matches your ask, and we can produce the requested evidence pack.

Key points up front:
- No-model-learning: By default, hosted requests are processed without using prompts/responses to update or fine-tune any model weights. We can include this as an attestation and a DPA amendment for the pilot period.
- Export path: We support SFTP export and API exports. We can generate an on-demand export containing prompts, responses, and metadata for the retention window you specify.
- Retention: For pilot customers we typically hold logs for 30 days by default; we can configure shorter or configure a rolling-ephemeral mode per contract.

Next steps I propose: (1) Kar (karthik_iyer) will own the attestation PDF and fill the procurement form, (2) Lauren will attach an ops-level diagram and export instructions, and (3) I will route the DocuSign-ready attestation to your procurement contact. Can we target end of day Thursday for the first pass?

On a sensitive note — any internal references to training or model improvement in our public docs refer to opt-in programs only; we will not enable any learning pathways for your tenant without explicit, signed change control.

Jonas Weber
Head of Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Hello Elena / Procurement,

Thanks — sending the deliverables below. Please find attached:

1) non_learning_attestation.pdf — states operational commitment that NimbleHealth tenant activity will not be used to train, update, or fine-tune models without prior written consent. Includes an explicit pilot window (start/end dates) and a signature block for DocuSign.

2) dataflow_diagram.png — simplified ops diagram indicating ephemeral KV cache, S3 logs (us-west-2), and a no-write channel to our model training pipeline. Subprocessor access is limited to our logging provider (LogStream Inc.) and is listed with access controls in the attestation appendix.

3) sample_export.json (inline snippet below, full file available via SFTP):

{"timestamp":"2026-09-09T02:00:00Z","request_id":"req_8a7b4","prompt":"Patient presents with cough and fever. Triage:","response":"Recommend telehealth follow-up. (redacted PHI)"}

Notes and operational points:
- Retention: logs retained 30 days by default; we can set to 7 days for the pilot if you require.
- Export path: SFTP credentials will be provisioned to procurement once DocuSign is complete; exports can be run on-demand or scheduled nightly.
- Proof: We will provide a single-day export sample to confirm formatting and PII masking; the sample above has token-level IDs replaced to avoid PHI leakage.

Related links: DocuSign envelope for the attestation https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123def456 and our attestation template https://app.redwood.com/docs/attestations/non-learning-template

If this matches, we'll send the DocuSign envelope now and provision SFTP access immediately after signature.
